mapper.sql: id, workspace_id, issue_id, agent_id, status, priority, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_task_queue (id, workspace_id, issue_id, agent_id, status, priority, context, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{issueId}, #{agentId}, #{status}, #{priority}, #{context}::jsonb, #{createdAt}) ON CONFLICT (issue_id, agent_id) WHERE status IN ('queued', 'dispatched') DO NOTHING
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM agent_task_queue WHERE issue_id = #{issueId} AND agent_id = #{agentId} AND status IN ('queued', 'dispatched') ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT 1
